culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Ask locally. GSGSSI Visitor Code of Conduct ashore: follow staff instructions and stay with your group. Keep at least 5 m from wildlife, 10 m from nesting birds, 25 m from displaying albatross and 50 m from giant petrels. Don't touch, feed or collect anything. Clean boots and gear before every landing (biosecurity), and bring no fresh food ashore.

laws.rule: Since 1 August 2025 every visitor needs an Entry (Visitor) Permit under the Entry Control Ordinance 2022, applied for online and paid at least 14 days before arrival; GBP 250, valid 40 days, not issued within 3 days of arrival.

Breaching the biosecurity protocols is an offence: clean and inspect clothing and gear before arrival and between sites, wash boots and dip them in biocide before every landing, take no fresh fruit, vegetables, meat, eggs or unpasteurised dairy ashore, keep at least 5 m from wildlife and carcasses, and don't sit, kneel or lie on the ground.
